why_this_exists: Cloning either public repository gives you PDFs, and only the papers that repository owns. This corpus carries every active paper as navigable text in both repositories, plus still-shipped retired manuscripts in their home repository, so an agent with no network can read, cite, and cross-check the public evidence.
generated_from: the private system repository; do not hand-edit this directory
authority_order: checked Lean source is proof authority; the claims registry owns public status and coordinates; methodology owns transition rules; the paper owns exposition
reading_the_generated_markdown: The Markdown is a projection of the .tex, not a replacement. It resolves theorem numbers, cross-references, and Lean source links that the source only implies. The .tex is the manuscript and the hash of record; where they disagree, the .tex wins.

verification_boundary.note: No Lean kernel ran during this export. Reading a paper, or its generated text, is not checking a proof.
